subject: Acme POC: evaluation plan, success criteria & eval methodology (follow-up)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme POC: post-call recap + proposed success criteria (action needed)

Hi John — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of objectives
- Surface accurate product-recommendation answers from your internal catalog + knowledge base
- Keep latency under 300ms median for single-item lookups
- Maintain hallucination rate < 2% on priority queries

Proposed POC success criteria (attached: poc_success_criteria_v1.xlsx)
- Accuracy: Top-1 correctness on a 500-sample offline eval >= 88%
- Safety/hallucinations: false/unsupported content rate <= 2% on the same eval
- Latency: median end-to-end < 300ms for 95% of requests under test load
- Cost: token-cost per 1k <= $X (we'll tune batching/quant)

Eval methodology options to confirm
1) Offline evals: curated prompts + expected answers (fast iteration, deterministic grading)
2) Online shadow: run model alongside prod traffic in read-only mode (best signal, more setup)

Suggested owners / roles
- Acme: John (POC sponsor), Sara (data owner)
- Redwood: Marissa (POC PM / eval lead), Dylan (commercial owner), Rachel (SRE/observability)

Timeline (flexible)
- Confirm criteria + methodology by 2027-07-22
- Dataset & access handed off by 2027-07-29
- POC run window: 3 weeks starting target 2027-08-02

Ask: please confirm two things by Friday 2027-07-22:
- Preferred eval method (offline, shadow, or hybrid)
- Agreement on owners and the proposed timeline

Attachments: poc_success_criteria_v1.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Acme POC: post-call recap + proposed success criteria (action needed)

Hi John / team — thanks, and good plan. Per your request, below is a concise proposal for the eval methodology and grading rubric. I attached a working doc (evals_plan_v1.md) in the drive link as well.

Phase A — Offline eval (week 0 — pre-POC)
- Dataset: 500 curated examples drawn from your priority intents (we'll provide template ingestion CSV).
- Grading rubric (per-sample):
  - Score 2 (Pass): Answer is correct, concise, and cites correct product/data where applicable
  - Score 1 (Partial): Answer is useful but missing a key detail or contains minor formatting issues
  - Score 0 (Fail): Incorrect, unsafe, or hallucinated content
- Pass threshold: mean score >= 1.7 across priority set (equivalent to >= 88% Top-1 correctness)
- Additional metrics: BLEU/ROUGE not required — we'll rely on exact-match + human spot checks for open-answer prompts.

Phase B — Online shadow (week 1 of POC)
- Scope: 10% of non-sensitive traffic routed to shadow model (read-only). No changes to user experience.
- Monitoring: per-request latency, confidence score, hallucination detector flag, token counts, and sample mismatches forwarded to a review queue.
- Gating criteria to proceed from shadow to broader acceptance:
  - Shadow mismatch rate <= 5% on labeled samples
  - No critical safety incidents (policy hits)
  - Median latency within 1.5x of baseline

Ownership & handoffs
- Redwood (Marissa): prepare offline eval CSV, scoring sheet, and shared Drive folder; run initial offline passes and share results
- Acme (John / Sara): provide dataset, label guidance, and approval for shadowing subset of traffic; security/infrastructure OK for shadow
- Redwood (Dev): infra prep for shadow (networking, keys, read-only routing), coordinate with Acme security

Deliverables / timeline recap
- By 2027-07-22: confirm method and owners (ACTION: John)
- By 2027-07-29: dataset + access in Drive, initial offline run started
- POC window: 2027-07-26 (requested start) to 2027-08-16 (3 weeks) — adjust if needed

Notes about grading: we'll provide a shared Google Sheet with per-sample scoring and an aggregated dashboard. Human reviewers will be internal to both teams for the first run to align on subjective cases.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc-evals  (evals_plan_v1.md attached in folder)

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, POCs
Redwood Inference
